notes:
CRM notes (fragments/quotes allowed):
- Account summary: large omnichannel retailer platform building personalization + conversational support layers. Heavy on embeddings for product similarity and reranking for recommendations.
- Technical asks: p95 chat latency <150ms, embeddings throughput ~500qps, support for quantized LLMs for cost, KV/prefix caching, ability to pin model versions during holiday peak.
- Security: required SSO/SAML, KMS integration with existing AWS Key policies, SOC2 compliance evidence, 7-year audit log retention for fraud tracing, data residency for EU catalogs.
- Procurement angle: already on multi-year committed spend with AWS; procurement + infra leadership looking to reduce vendor sprawl. Quote from procurement lead: "we prefer a single cloud bill and native endpoints — simplifies procurement and our security attestations."
- POC notes: Redwood POC showed good perf; SE identified optimizations (batching, cache hits) and estimated 20-30% cost savings vs naive self-hosting. Nebula liked runtime but procurement worried about timeline for Private + KMS on-prem integration.
- Stalling signals: late Oct procurement asked for reference customers on Private deployment under aggressive timeline; team couldn't provide case studies in time. Also internal champion (Head of AI) accepted new role and stopped pushing for Redwood.
- Post-decision: Sales attempted a counter-offer (dedicated reserved capacity + accelerated Private ramp plan) but procurement maintained preference for managed endpoints with zero vendor ops.
- Action items recorded: archive opportunity, add to "hyperscaler-lost" nurture segment, prepare a short teardown of POC results and cost delta vs Bedrock for FY26 re-engagement.
public_notes: Closed-lost to AWS managed endpoints. Primary reasons: existing AWS commitment, procurement preference, KMS/audit integration timeline, no internal champion after org change. Follow-up scheduled in ~9 months to re-evaluate after peak season.
